papers.title: Ramsey Theory for Edge Ideals
papers.abstract: We initiate the study of Ramsey theory for edge ideals. The edge ideal I_G is generated by the monomials x_ux_v for all edges uv of G. A central invariant measuring structure in algebraic geometry and commutative algebra are the betti number beta_{i,j}(S/I) for some ideal I in a ring S. We prove the Ramsey Theorem for Edge Ideals: For any betti number indices i,j, and any number of colors m, there is a graph F such that for every m-coloring of the edges of F, there is a color l such that beta_{i,j}(S/I_{F_l}) >0, where F_l is the subgraph of F whose edges are in color l. Moreover, the number of vertices of F is at most jm^2.

papers.title: Iterated socles and closure operations
papers.abstract: Let $(R,\mathfrak m)$ be a $d$-dimensional Cohen--Macaulay local ring, $d\geq2$ containing a field, and let $J\subseteq\mathfrak m^s$ be a parameter ideal with $s\geq2$, also, in the mixed case via some mild assumptions. We prove for that $J:\mathfrak m^{(d-1)(s-1)}\subseteq\overline{J}$, and that $J:\mathfrak m^{(d-1)(s-1)+1}\subseteq\overline{J}$ when $R$ is not regular. We show that Cohen--Macaulayness cannot be removed. We also prove the characteristic-free exact formula $g(J)=(d-1)(s-1)+r$ for parameter ideals of order $s$ with a level tangent cone, giving singular mixed-characteristic Gorenstein and non-Gorenstein examples in which the singular bound is attained.

papers.title: $k-$Absorbing factorization in multiplicative lattices
papers.abstract: We study the multiplicative $C-$lattices generated by principal elements in which every proper element is a finite product of $k-$absorbing elements. We prove that such lattices have Krull dimension at most one. In the modular case, a finite direct product decomposition theorem is obtained.

papers.title: A Cohen--Macaulay Analogue of the Brodmann--Rotthaus Theorem
papers.abstract: We prove a Cohen--Macaulay analogue of the theorem of Brodmann and Rotthaus on the lifting of quasi-excellence. More precisely, let $A$ be a Noetherian ring and let $I$ be an ideal contained in the Jacobson radical of $A$. We show that if $A/I$ is $\mathsf{CM}$-Q0 and $A$ is a $\mathsf{CM}$\textnormal{-G-}ring, then $A$ is $\mathsf{CM}$-quasi-excellent. Our proof follows the strategy of Kurano and Shimomoto and makes essential use of \v{C}esnavi\v{c}ius' Macaulayfication theorem.

papers.title: Regularity and stabilization of integral closures of powers of homogeneous ideals
papers.abstract: In this paper, we establish explicit polynomial bounds for the regularity defect and the stabilization index of integral closures of powers of arbitrary homogeneous ideals over fields of any characteristic. Specifically, let $I \subseteq K[x_{1}, \dots, x_{n}]$ be a nonzero proper homogeneous ideal generated in degrees at most $d$. We prove that $\reg \overline{I^{s}} \le \rho(I)s + d^{(n-1)2^{n}}$ for every $s \ge 1$, where $\rho(I) \le d$ denotes the eventual slope of $\reg \overline{I^{s}}$. Furthermore, the stabilization bound is polynomial in $d$ for a fixed number of variables $n$. In characteristic zero, an upper bound for the first Hilbert coefficient yields a significantly sharper exponent. Our approach relies on exact equigenerated reductions, free lattice constructions within normalized Rees algebras, monic Frobenius presentations, and Tor-module regularity controls, complemented by generic source hyperplanes that reduce the stabilization behavior to the eventual nonvanishing of graded components.

papers.title: Singularities of ideals with minimal tangent space dimension in the Hilbert scheme of points on a threefold
papers.abstract: We classify all singular monomial ideals in the Hilbert scheme of $d$ points on $\mathbb{A}^3$ whose tangent spaces have the minimal dimension $3d+6$. There are two families called the opera houses and rotating staircases, and we give their combinatorial and algebraic descriptions. All the opera houses are in one linkage class, and their singularities are smoothly equivalent to the vertex of a cone over the Grassmannian $\mathrm{Gr}(2,6) \hookrightarrow \mathbb{P}^{14}$ in its Pl\"ucker embedding. The rotating staircases split into many linkage classes and we give some examples.

papers.title: A Characterization of Completely Integrally Closed Pr\"{u}fer $v$-Multiplication Domains
papers.abstract: We generalize a result known for Pr\"ufer domains to show that a PVMD $R$ is completely integrally closed if and only if $\text{Inv}^t(R)$ is an archimedean $\ell$-group. It has been conjectured that a PVMD is completely integrally closed if and only if it is an Archimedean domain. It is known that a completely integrally closed PVMD is an Archimedean domain. We provide an example to illustrate that an Archimedean PVMD need not be completely integrally closed.
